verdict.rationale: Better Auth stores auth data in the developer's own database rather than a vendor cloud, and community reviews note users "own all the data" and can run migrations via a single CLI command, giving indirect control over retention/deletion. However, there is no documented first-party API or plugin for user-initiated account/data deletion, retention policy configuration, or GDPR-style erasure beyond session revocation. Missing for 10: explicit account/data deletion endpoint, configurable retention windows, and documentation addressing data-subject deletion requests.
